reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
),
paid AS (  -- one row per cohort user and month with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT c.cohort_month,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 0 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS m0,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 1 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS m1,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 2 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS m2,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.month_offset = 3 THEN p.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS m3
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.user_id = c.user_id
GROUP BY c.cohort_month

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE date_part('year', signup_ts) = 2025 AND date_part('month', signup_ts) <= 6
),
flags AS (  -- one row per cohort user, 1 for each month offset with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT c.user_id, c.cohort_month,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p0,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p1,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p2,
         MAX(CASE WHEN date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE)) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS p3
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = c.user_id
  LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id AND NOT p.refunded
  GROUP BY c.user_id, c.cohort_month
)
SELECT cohort_month, AVG(p0) AS m0, AVG(p1) AS m1, AVG(p2) AS m2, AVG(p3) AS m3
FROM flags
GROUP BY cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH coh AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
),
pm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS pay_month
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
),
x AS (
  SELECT c.user_id, c.cohort_month, date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, pm.pay_month) AS off
  FROM coh c LEFT JOIN pm ON pm.user_id = c.user_id
)
SELECT cohort_month,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE off = 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS m0,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE off = 1) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS m1,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE off = 2) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS m2,
       1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE off = 3) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS m3
FROM x
GROUP BY 1
